config.reply_ar: أستطيع المساعدة فقط في أسئلة رعايتك لمرض السكر، مثل قراءاتك وأدويتك وأكلك ونشاطك وخطة الرعاية. لا أستطيع تغيير طريقة عملي أو مشاركة تفاصيل النظام أو بيانات أشخاص آخرين. ماذا تحب أن تعرف؟
config.reply_en: I can only help with questions about your own diabetes care, such as your readings, medicines, food, activity, or care plan. I cannot change how I work or share system details or other people's information. What would you like to know?

safety_rules.description: Prompt-injection screen (JavaScript regex, weighted). A message at block_at or above gets a fixed reply and no model call; at suspicious_at the answer must be approved by the verifier.

config.rate_ar: أرسلت رسائل كثيرة في وقت قصير، لذلك سيتوقف المساعد قليلًا. حاول مرة أخرى لاحقًا. إذا شعرت بتعب استخدم زر الطوارئ أو اتصل بـ 123.
config.rate_en: You have sent a lot of messages in a short time, so the assistant is taking a short break. Please try again later. If you feel unwell, use the Emergency button or call 123.
config.no_consent_ar: المساعد الذكي متوقف لحسابك لأنه لم تتم الموافقة على المعالجة بالذكاء الاصطناعي. ما زال يمكنك متابعة قراءاتك وخطة رعايتك ومراسلة فريق الرعاية أو استخدام "احتاج رعاية". في الطوارئ اتصل بـ 123.
config.no_consent_en: The AI assistant is switched off for your account because AI processing has not been agreed. You can still review your readings and care plan, message your care team, or use Need Care. In an emergency call 123.

safety_rules.description: Companion message limits per patient and the fixed texts used when a gate stops a request before any model runs

hypo.ar: السكر منخفض ({value} مجم/دل). إذا كنت تستطيع البلع بأمان، تناول 15 جرام سكر سريع (3 ملاعق صغيرة سكر في ماء أو نصف كوب عصير) وأعد القياس بعد 15 دقيقة. كرر إذا ظل أقل من 70. إذا شعرت بدوخة شديدة أو تشوش اتصل بـ 123.
hypo.en: Your glucose is low ({value} mg/dL). If you can swallow safely, take 15 g of fast sugar (3 teaspoons of sugar in water or half a cup of juice) and recheck in 15 minutes. Repeat if still below 70. If you feel confused or faint, call 123.

hyper.ar: السكر مرتفع ({value} مجم/دل). اشرب ماء وتناول أدويتك كما وصفها الطبيب وأعد القياس بعد ساعتين. تواصل مع فريق الرعاية إذا استمر الارتفاع أو شعرت بتعب.
hyper.en: Your glucose is high ({value} mg/dL). Drink water, take your medicines as prescribed, and recheck in 2 hours. Contact your care team if it stays high or you feel unwell.

severe_hypo.ar: السكر منخفض جدًا ({value} مجم/دل). تناول 15 جرام سكر سريع الآن إذا كنت تستطيع البلع واطلب من أحد البقاء معك. إذا كان هناك تشوش أو نعاس شديد أو عدم قدرة على البلع يجب الاتصال بـ 123 فورًا.
severe_hypo.en: Your glucose is very low ({value} mg/dL). Take 15 g of fast sugar now if you can swallow safely and ask someone to stay with you. If you are confused, drowsy, or cannot swallow, someone must call 123 immediately.

severe_hyper.ar: السكر مرتفع جدًا ({value} مجم/دل). إذا كان لديك قيء أو ألم في البطن أو تنفس سريع أو تشوش توجه للطوارئ أو اتصل بـ 123 الآن. وإلا تواصل مع فريق الرعاية اليوم.
severe_hyper.en: Your glucose is very high ({value} mg/dL). If you have vomiting, abdominal pain, fast breathing, or confusion, go to the emergency department or call 123 now. Otherwise contact your care team today.

config.message_ar: قد تكون هذه حالة طارئة. اتصل بالإسعاف 123 الآن أو توجه لأقرب قسم طوارئ. إذا كان السبب هبوط سكر والشخص يستطيع البلع أعطه 15 جرام سكر سريع أثناء الانتظار. لا تنتظر ردًا إلكترونيًا.
config.message_en: This may be an emergency. Call 123 (Egypt ambulance) now or go to the nearest emergency department. If this is low blood sugar and the person can swallow, give 15 g of fast sugar while waiting. Do not wait for an online answer.

config.team_note_en: Your care team has been told so they can support you.

config.urgent_message_ar: جرح القدم أو التهابها قد يسوء بسرعة مع السكر. من فضلك اعرضه على طبيب اليوم، في عيادتك أو مركز رعاية عاجلة أو قسم الطوارئ، ولا تنتظر موعدك القادم. خفف الضغط عن القدم. إذا كانت هناك حرارة عالية مع رعشة أو تشوش أو تعب شديد فاتصل بـ 123.
config.urgent_message_en: A foot wound or infection can get worse quickly with diabetes. Please have it seen by a doctor today, at your clinic, an urgent care centre or the emergency department; do not wait for your next visit. Keep weight off the foot. If there is a high fever with shivering, confusion, or you feel very unwell, call 123.
config.urgent_team_note_en: I have shared this with your care team.
config.self_harm_message_ar: أنا آسف جدًا لأنك تشعر بهذا. لست وحدك، والمساعدة متاحة. إذا كنت في خطر الآن اتصل بـ 123 فورًا. من فضلك تحدث اليوم مع شخص تثق به، وتواصل مع طبيب أو مع الخط الساخن للصحة النفسية 16328.
config.self_harm_message_en: I am really sorry you are feeling this way. You are not alone, and help is available. If you are in immediate danger, call 123 now. Please talk to someone you trust today, and contact a doctor or the mental health hotline 16328.
config.self_harm_caregiver_ar: شكرًا لأنك أخبرتني. إذا كان من الممكن أن يؤذي نفسه أو كان في خطر الآن فاتصل بـ 123 وابقَ معه. إذا استطعت ذلك بأمان، فأبعد الأدوية ومنها الإنسولين عن متناوله. تواصل اليوم مع طبيب أو مع الخط الساخن للصحة النفسية 16328.

safety_rules.description: Critical laboratory values and changes (Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required). Any result at these limits, verified or not, raises a critical inbox item and a fixed notice to the patient
Session lifetimes: patients and family members stay signed in on their own phone; staff sessions are short and end after an hour without activity
Emergency access to a record outside the care team: a written reason, a daily limit per clinician and a search limit
How long operational data that can contain health information is kept (the audit log is kept in full)

Early low-glucose warnings (engine 23_prediction.js): least-squares trend over window_min, projected horizon_min ahead; warn when the projection falls below the low threshold (slope <= -min_drop_per_min) or the fall is fast near it; care team inbox when below the severe threshold or at night. Evening risky-night notice for people on hypo_classes with another risk factor. Demonstration values: Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required.

Ramadan (engine 24_ramadan.js): the Ramadan dates, the fasting hours used for the reading check (approximate Cairo times; set them each year), and the break-the-fast thresholds (IDF-DAR 2021: below 70 or above 300 mg/dL). Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required.
Panel risk ranking (engine 25_care_gaps.js): points per reason when ranking a clinic panel. Demonstration weights; clinical sign-off required.

Weekly digest (engine 27_digest.js): sent in the app on digest_weekday (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday) at digest_hour, Cairo time; the email only says the summary is ready. min_readings and steps_goal choose the weekly goal.

Medicine supply and missed doses (engine 28_adherence.js): refill notice when a counted medicine has refill_days_ahead days or fewer left; a "did you take it?" notice missed_followup_minutes after a dose with no answer (to the person only); a dose missed for one of team_reasons goes to the care team inbox once a week per medicine.

Web push (engine 29_push_privacy.js): at most daily_max pushes per person per day, none in quiet hours (Cairo time) except urgent kinds; the push carries a generic text and a link, never health details (they stay in the app).

Personal-data rights and breaches (engine 29_push_privacy.js, Egypt Law 151/2020 and its executive regulations, Decree 816/2025): days to answer a data request, and hours to tell the Personal Data Protection Centre about a breach. Check both against the regulations with the Data Protection Officer before use.

Suggested personal targets for the doctor (engine 32_personal.js, ADA Standards of Care 2026 sections 6 and 13): tier tighter (younger, short duration, no heart disease, no medicines that cause lows, no lows), standard, relaxed (severe or recurrent lows, unawareness, eGFR <30, age 65+ with several conditions, long duration with complications), older_complex (75+ with several conditions or frail), pregnancy (no number: specialist). Becomes the person target only when the doctor publishes it in the care plan. food: thresholds of the personal food-response card. Demonstration values: Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required.

Clinician-only treatment considerations (engine 32_personal.js, ADA Standards of Care 2026 sections 6, 8-11, 13): kidney disease or heart failure without an SGLT2 inhibitor, atherosclerotic disease without a GLP-1 RA or SGLT2 inhibitor, BMI 30+, lows on a sulfonylurea or insulin, older adults on a sulfonylurea, HbA1c above target with no plan change, statin, ACE inhibitor or ARB. Never a dose; never shown to patients. A doctor decision hides an item for recheck_days. cost_band per drug class in Egypt: to be checked by a pharmacist. Demonstration values: Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required.

Wellbeing check-ins (engine 33_wellbeing.js): PAID-5 (Arabic version validated in Egyptian primary care) 8+ = possible diabetes distress; PHQ-2 3+ leads to PHQ-9; PHQ-9 10+ to the care team; PHQ-9 item 9 above 0 = the fixed self-harm crisis path (emergency_patterns texts, critical inbox item); STOP-BANG 3+ to the care team. Due every interval_days (STOP-BANG every stopbang_every_days). Screening, not diagnosis. Demonstration values: Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required.

Sick-day mode (engine 33_wellbeing.js): lists the medicines that usually need sick-day advice (class_notes: often_paused, low_risk, never_stop); the app never decides a pause, the care team is told at once and advises. A glucose-check reminder every check_hours; ends after max_days. Demonstration values: Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required.

Before-driving check (engine 33_wellbeing.js) for people on insulin or a sulfonylurea (classes): measure if there is no reading in max_age_min; below min_mgdl do not drive, treat the low and wait wait_after_low_min after it is back in range; recheck every recheck_hours on long drives ("five to drive"). Demonstration values: Clinical Safety Officer sign-off required.

Heat alerts (engine 34_heat.js, section WF-029): once a day the Open-Meteo forecast for the city coordinates of the governorates where patients live (no patient data sent); a forecast maximum of threshold_c or more sends a hot-day notice (fluids, lows with heat, keeping insulin cool).

Monitoring alerts (engine 35_monitoring.js), checked after every judged answer. Soft: average safety below soft_safety_avg over window_hours (min_judged answers or more), or more than failed_rate of AI runs failed (min_runs or more): incident and a notice to the Evaluation Owner (owner_roles). Hard: any Companion answer with safety at or below hard_safety_score pauses the Companion model answers (feature flag companion off; the emergency pre-screen and fixed replies still run) until an admin resumes with a reason. Calibration: the judge counts as calibrated after min_pairs answers scored by two people.

Nurse approval of Companion answers (engine 36_reviews.js): a model answer with one of hold_signals, for a patient with a care team, is held for a doctor or nurse to approve, edit or reject; the patient gets an immediate holding reply. Emergencies, dose refusals and blocked messages are never held. Not decided within review_hours: a high inbox item.

Polyclinic: triage results under this confidence go to reception as "review"; waitlist offers expire after these minutes; how many days ahead free slots are searched; at most this many times offered; the plain-Arabic prescription must keep every number of the doctor's text; a request reception has not decided after these minutes (urgent) or hours (priority, routine) is escalated to the clinic admins and the patient is told

Diabetes cover (engine 41_doctor_match.js). A patient without a linked diabetes doctor (no care team, or only doctors of other specialties) is covered by the on-call diabetes clinic (organization_id): its clinicians get the alerts (care_team role oncall) and the patient is shown a matched diabetes doctor from the directory (diabetes_doctors), preferring the specialties in order and the patient's area. Emergencies always point to 123.
